title: Micah Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Micah 6: Yahweh's controversy with his people, what he requires of man, and the dishonest scales.

questions.text: Before whom is the hearer told to plead his case?
questions.explanation: Micah 6:1 says to arise and plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.

questions.text: With whom does the text say Yahweh will contend?
questions.explanation: Micah 6:2 says Yahweh has a controversy with his people, and he will contend with Israel.

questions.text: Out of which land does Yahweh say he brought his people up?
questions.explanation: Micah 6:4 says he brought them up out of the land of Egypt and redeemed them out of the house of bondage.

questions.text: Whom does Yahweh say he sent before his people?
questions.explanation: Micah 6:4 says Yahweh sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam before them.

questions.text: Who is Balak called in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Micah 6:5 calls Balak the king of Moab, and tells the people to remember what he devised.

questions.text: Whose son is Balaam said to be?
questions.explanation: Micah 6:5 calls Balaam the son of Beor, who answered Balak from Shittim to Gilgal.

questions.text: What offering does the speaker ask whether Yahweh will be pleased with in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Micah 6:7 asks whether Yahweh will be pleased with thousands of rams.

questions.text: What does verse 8 say Yahweh requires of man?
questions.explanation: Micah 6:8 says he has shown man what is good: to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.

answers.text: To build altars, to keep feasts, and to offer bulls at the temple
To act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with God
To fast often, to give alms, and to sing in the assembly
To seek signs, to honor kings, and to count the years of peace

questions.text: According to verse 15, what will happen when they sow?
questions.explanation: Micah 6:15 says you will sow, but won't reap, and will tread the olives but not anoint yourself with oil.

questions.text: Whose statutes does the text say are kept?
questions.explanation: Micah 6:16 says the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab's house.
